filing_office: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations
filing_fee_notes: Mandatory total: 100 filing fee plus 25 registered-agent designation fee. This state fee does not buy registered-agent services.
registered_agent_rules: Appoint an individual or eligible entity with a physical Florida street address. The agent must accept appointment; the LLC cannot be its own agent.
annual_report_due: January 1 through May 1 each year; filings after May 1 incur a 400 late fee.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Florida Department of Revenue, Reemployment Tax
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and appoint a Florida registered agent. File the annual report on time to avoid the late fee.
common_mistake: Confusing the annual report with a tax return.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Fee schedule and report help were available in official indexed results; direct requests were blocked or redirected to scheduled maintenance. First-report year, name-search URL, formation processing time, expedite options, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed. Florida DOR administers employer unemployment tax; Commerce administers benefits.
